judgment_text:
Prayer : This contempt petition filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 to punish and prosecute the 1st to 5th respondents, for misuse of power and post, willfully knowingly and deliberately disobeying the orders of the Hon'ble single Bench of this Court dated 4-8-2025 made in W.P. No. 28108 of 2025, even after having the knowledge of court

ORDER

This contempt petition has been filed seeking to punish the respondent for wilful disobedience of the order dated 4-8-2025 passed by this Court in W.P. No. 28108 of 2025.

2. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, learned government advocate for the respondents submitted that, the order under contempt has been complied with and he also produced the proceedings of the Revenue Divisional Officer, Coimbatore (North), dated 21-3-2026 to that effect before this Court today.

3. In view of the above submission made by the learned government advocate for the respondents, this contempt petition stands closed.
